brand_data.about_en:
As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category –offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

data.title: IT Helpdesk
data.role_description:
IT Helpdesk

POSITION SNAPSHOT
Location: Head Office/ Tehran /Iran
Full-time.

POSITION SUMMARY
The IT Help Desk Specialist is responsible for researching, diagnosing, resolving problems, and supporting day-to-day first level of windows, workstations, printers, etc. according to the agreed SLA and responsibility definitions between LGO and the user community.

A DAY IN THE LIFE …

The tasks include, but are not limited to

• Install desktop, laptop, tablet, printers, and other required infrastructure components and perform upgrades and replacements of these components, whenever necessary.
• Help users and execute and maintain user administration processes and procedures for local markets supported by the customer care unit; this includes AD administration functions.
• Resolve all LGO user access-related problem tickets within SLA timeframes and GLOBE standards.
• Manage incidents and assets in the IT infrastructure area, and ensure that they are properly escalated to the GC.
• Coordinate with LGO customer care and GC support teams in resolving IT infrastructure issues in their market, e.g., Server, and workstation operations in all sites in the markets/region.
• Support Microsoft/Non-Microsoft software in the sites of Iran.
• Respond to access-related security issues by providing relevant information and sending relevant KPI reports.
• Compliant and security SOPs implementation and administration for the site responsibilities.
• IT asset management.
• Participate in the local IT infrastructure project in the market.
• Maintain customer focus: ensure that he or she has an understanding and afford business needs with a level of priorities required.

The contract for this position will be with another company.
Please only apply if you have no problem having external contact (not with Nestle).

What will make you successful?

Technical/Functional:
• Skills in the required technology area.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Communications skills.
• Ability to work in a team.
• Ability to work under pressure.
• Full understanding of Windows 10/11.
• Understanding of network cabling.

Experience:
• 2 to 3 years of experience in one or more of the required technology specializations and/or suitable tertiary qualifications in information technology.

Qualifications:
• Relevant degree or equivalent:
• MCSA Certificate.
• CCNA Certificate.

Knowledge:
• Knowledge of English.

data.title: Cloud Engineer
data.role_description:
Cloud Engineer
About the Role
We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer to join our growing engineering team at RFactorial. In this role, you will design, build, and operate the infrastructure powering our AI and cloud orchestration platform across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
The ideal candidate is a proactive engineer with strong expertise in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networking, and distributed systems. You should be comfortable working across the infrastructure stack—from compute and networking to storage and automation—and be capable of building scalable, reliable platforms for modern AI workloads.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
• Design, build, and operate multi-cluster Kubernetes environments.
• Develop infrastructure across cloud, on-premises, and virtualized environments.
• Build systems for cluster provisioning, workload scheduling, isolation, and autoscaling.
• Design and maintain infrastructure automation using Infrastructure as Code.
• Work across the infrastructure stack, including servers, networking, storage, containers, and orchestration platforms.
• Optimize infrastructure performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
• Collaborate closely with backend, platform, and AI engineering teams.
• Contribute to infrastructure architecture, technical discussions, and engineering best practices.
• Troubleshoot production infrastructure issues and continuously improve platform reliability.
• Contribute to documentation, automation, and operational excellence.
________________________________________
Required Skills & Experience
• Minimum 3 years of professional experience in cloud or infrastructure engineering.
• Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
• Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and distributed systems.
• Experience designing and managing cloud, on-premises, or hybrid infrastructure.
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
• Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
• Good understanding of networking concepts, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and datacenter networking.
• Familiarity with server hardware, virtualization, and infrastructure components.
• Understanding of storage technologies, including distributed storage, object storage, and network-attached storage.
• Experience with Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
• Strong troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and documentation skills.
________________________________________
Nice to Have
• Experience with GPU infrastructure and the NVIDIA ecosystem.
• Knowledge of high-performance networking technologies such as InfiniBand.
• Experience with workflow orchestration platforms such as Argo Workflows or Apache Airflow.
• Familiarity with distributed storage platforms such as Ceph.
• Relevant networking certifications such as CCNP or equivalent experience.
________________________________________
Location / Type
On-site – Tehran
Full-time
________________________________________
Why Join Us?
• Work on cutting-edge AI and cloud-native technologies.
• Build the infrastructure powering next-generation GPU and AI platforms.
• High ownership and autonomy.
• Competitive compensation and equity.
• Opportunity to shape a category-defining platform from an early stage.

data.title: Product Owner
data.role_description:
Responsibilities: Analyzing and documenting the requirements of users and stakeholders Writing accurate and understandable user stories and managing the product backlog Defining and implementing the product roadmap Managing effective communication with internal and external stakeholders Participating in scrum meetings of the development team to clarify tasks and clarifying ambiguities Planning and managing the product life cycle (Product Lifecycle) Directing OKRs or quarterly product goals and monitoring on their progress
Holding and facilitating Sprint Planning, Review and Retrospective meetings. Working closely with the development and support team to provide the best possible experience
* Required skills and experiences:
Complete mastery of Agile methodologies, especially Scrum
Familiarity with project management tools, especially Jira
Familiarity with documentation tools such as Confluence or Notion. At least two years of work experience in the role of product owner or similar role
Ability to prioritize, make decisions Fast and working in challenging environments
High skill in effective communication, both in the team and with external stakeholders
Analytical thinking and familiarity with the concepts of KPI and product success indicators
It is considered an advantage if:
You are interested in user experience (UX) and data analysis
Familiar with the concepts and applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in digital products
Have experience working with Data Science or Machine Learning teams

تیم آهن پیشتاز برگرفته از افرادی متخصص، پویا و جوان است؛ ما در آهن پیشتاز همواره به صورت گروهی تلاش می‌کنیم نیازهای مشتریان را در حوزه فولاد و آهن برطرف کنیم.
تیم ما متشکل شده از افرادی، که از طریق دانش فنی و مهارت‌های حرفه‌ای خود، به دنبال ارائه راهکارهای متنوع و انعطاف‌پذیر برای نیازهای صنعتی و ساختمانی مشتریان هستند.
با فروشگاه آنلاین ما، مشتریان می‌توانند به آسانی و در هر زمانی اقلام مورد نیاز خود را سفارش داده و از خدمات آهن فروشی آنلاین ما بهره‌برداری کنند. 
همچنین، تیم پشتیبانی ما در هر لحظه آماده است مشتریان را در انتخاب محصولات و پاسخگویی به سوالاتشان راهنمایی کند.
ما در آهن پیشتاز، از تکنولوژی پیشرفته و سیستم های امنیتی قوی استفاده می‌کنیم تا بهترین تجربه خرید آنلاین را برای مشتریان فراهم کنیم.
اگر شما یک فرد متخصص در حوزه کاری خود هستید و به دنبال جایی برای رشد، آن هم در حوزه فروش آهن آلات هستید، آهن پیشتاز می‌تواند همان شریکی باشد که به دنبالش هستید. ما از همکاری با شما و ایجاد رابطه ای بلندمدت و مفید برای هر دو طرف استقبال می‌کنیم.
اگر علاقه‌مند به همکاری با ما هستید و می‌خواهید با تیمی جوان و پویا وارد دنیای فروش آهن آلات و بازرگانی استیل شوید، لطفاً رزومه خود را به همراه اطلاعات تماس ارسال کنید. ما با دقت به هر یک از درخواست‌ها پاسخ خواهیم داد و به تمام تلاش خود می‌کنیم تا یک فرایند استخدام سریع و موفق را برای شما فراهم کنیم.

boosted_positions.role_description:
اگر یک برنامه نویس خوش فکر و متخصصی، دوست داری در محیطی جوان و پویا مسیر رشد رو طی کنی، و خودت رو مناسب موقعیت شغلی مورد نیاز ما می دونی؛ باعث خوشحالی ماست که رزومه شما رو داشته باشیم.

مسئولیت‌ها:

تحلیل، طراحی و توسعه‌ی سرویس‌های Backend برای محصولات و پلتفرم‌های ابری شرکت با تمرکز بر کیفیت و تحویل سریع
ارائه راه‌حل برای ساختار سیستم، طراحی پایگاه‌داده و لایه‌ی ذخیره‌سازی با در نظر گرفتن مقیاس و پایداری
تصمیم‌گیری روی مرز ماژول‌ها در معماری Modular Monolith و DDD و حفظ سلامت boundary بین domainها
طراحی و پیاده‌سازی با اولویت رعایت اصول امنیتی (IDOR، OWASP، Gate، Policy)
استفاده‌ی موثر و هوشمندانه از ابزارهای AI (Cursor، Copilot، Claude ) برای افزایش سرعت توسعه، تست،code review و دیباگ
پیاده‌سازی ماژول‌های قابل استفاده‌ی مجدد و کدنویسی تمیز و قابل تست
توانایی بررسی و دیباگ سیستم در محیط پروداکشن و رفع bottleneckهای performance و امنیتی
مشارکت در code review با تمرکز ویژه روی مسائل امنیتی و authorization، و نهادینه‌سازی workflowهای AI-assisted در تیم
طراحی API امن و همکاری نزدیک با تیم Frontend روی contract و یکپارچه‌سازی


مهارت‌های مورد نیاز:

تسلط به زبان PHP و فرم ورک Laravel
تسلط به مفاهیم طراحی نرم‌افزار، پایگاه داده‌ها و الگوهای معماری
شناخت کافی از معماری‌های Modular Monolith و Service-based و آشنایی با Domain-Driven Design
تسلط به مباحث پایه‌ی امنیت در توسعه‌ی Web و APIشامل شناخت دقیق IDOR و توانایی طراحی کنترل دسترسی resource-level و تفکیک دقیق Authentication و Authorization و پیاده‌سازی صحیح آن
تجربه‌ی عملی استفاده از ابزارهای AI برای کدنویسی Cursor) ، Copilot،Claude ) توانایی نوشتنprompt موثر
آشنایی با Redis در نقش cache، queue و lock
توانایی طراحی و نوشتن تست (unit / feature)
تسلط به Git و gitflow
تسلط به دستورات CLI در لینوکس
آشنایی با Docker و درک مفاهیم containerization
آشنایی با CI/CD و فرآیندهای deploy خودکار
داشتن دید نسبت به زیرساخت‌های ابری (شبکه، مجازی‌سازی، storage) مزیت محسوب می‌شود
آشنایی با مباحث امنیتی محیط‌های multi-tenant مزیت محسوب می‌شود
آشنایی با NoSql (MongoDB, Elasticsearch) مزیت محسوب میشود
آشنایی با زبان‌های Backend دیگر مانند Go و Node.js مزیت محسوب می‌شود
آشنایی با فریم‌ورک‌های Frontend مزیت محسوب می‌شود
تجربه‌ی mentoring و رهبری فنی تیم مزیت محسوب می‌شود


سایر شرایط:
روز و ساعات کاری: شنبه تا چهارشنبه از ساعت 8 تا 16:45 با دو ساعت تایم شناور


مزایای همکاری با پارس پک:

دورکاری
امکان امریه دانش بنیان
بیمه تکمیلی با پوشش درمانی خوب
فرصت کسب تجربه در کنار تیمی حرفه ای و صمیمی
محیط کاری امن و زمینه مناسب جهت رشد و پیشرفت
